findings.title: Rime can treat a late per-batch done as final after eos
findings.details: Rime tracks only one pending drain when TextToSpeechDonePacket sends eos. Any provider done that was caused by an earlier text batch but arrives after eos is sent sees textClosed=true and pendingDrains=1, decrements the counter to zero, emits TextToSpeechEndPacket, closes the connection, and can overtake final eos audio. The current package test sends each pre-final done before TextToSpeechDonePacket, so it does not cover the ordering that the RFC explicitly calls out as pending batch done arriving after eos.
findings.rfc_requirement: TextToSpeechEndPacket follows final audio after text closure and all pending synthesis work has drained. Rime done is a per-batch drain, not a whole-message completion signal.

reproduction.output_excerpt: --- FAIL: TestRimeLatePreFinalDoneAfterEOSProbe: late pre-final done after eos emitted TextToSpeechEndPacket before final eos audio

findings.required_correction: Track outstanding Rime synthesis batches independently from the final eos drain so a stale or earlier batch done cannot satisfy the final message boundary. Add a regression where a pre-final done arrives after eos and before the eos audio or eos done.

findings.title: Neuphonic still fabricates successful synthesis completion on local text closure
findings.details: The Neuphonic implementation documents that there is no server-side completion acknowledgement, then emits TextToSpeechEndPacket directly when Transform receives TextToSpeechDonePacket. It also logs a failed stop write but still emits the successful End packet and TTSCompleted event. This violates the RFC requirement that no elapsed-time estimate or local close may fabricate successful final synthesis.
findings.rfc_requirement: TTS owns pending provider work, TextToSpeechEndPacket follows the final audio callback after all pending synthesis has drained, and timeout or provider failure is failure rather than successful completion.

reproduction.output_excerpt: --- FAIL: TestNeuphonicDoneDoesNotFabricateSuccessProbe: TextToSpeechDonePacket emitted TextToSpeechEndPacket without provider completion acknowledgement

findings.required_correction: Do not emit successful End for Neuphonic from local TextToSpeechDonePacket alone. If the provider cannot attest completion, keep the provider diagnostic-only for callback-authoritative playback or convert the no-ack closure into an error or unsupported-authoritative path with tests.
